auth_lifecycle.unauthenticated_behavior: Public customer routes remain anonymous. Protected operator routes with a missing or expired access token redirect to /operator/login and preserve the intended protected route only in ephemeral client state.
auth_lifecycle.forbidden_behavior: Render the Design System 403 state, disclose no protected claim data, and provide safe navigation without retry loops.
auth_lifecycle.logout_behavior: Clear the in-memory bearer token, operator identity, protected query cache and ephemeral auth state. No logout endpoint or refresh/session store is invented.

state_management.server_state_strategy: TanStack Query owns REST server state, request lifecycle and explicit query invalidation; no authoritative business state is recreated in a global client store.
state_management.ui_state_strategy: React component state and narrowly scoped context own ephemeral UI state such as form flow, dialogs, filters and the in-memory operator session.
state_management.cache_strategy: Query keys are operation/resource oriented. Protected cache is cleared on logout/401; mutations invalidate only affected canonical resources and refetch authoritative state before conflict recovery.

forms_validation.client_validation_strategy: React Hook Form with Zod schemas provides immediate structural and format feedback only; server eligibility, lifecycle and authorization rules are never duplicated as client authority.
forms_validation.api_validation_mapping: Map RFC 9457 422 errors to accessible field/global errors while preserving entered synthetic data where safe.
forms_validation.conflict_mapping: Map 409 Problem Details to the Design System conflict state, preserve context, refetch canonical state when required, and never pretend the mutation succeeded.
forms_validation.rate_limit_mapping: Map 429 plus Retry-After when present to restrained retry guidance and never create automatic retry storms.

observability.client_error_strategy: Capture sanitized route/operation context and the response requestId for diagnostics; never emit raw evidence, credentials, policy proof values or full claim payloads.
observability.pii_policy: Treat all demo customer/claim values as sensitive synthetic data: no bearer tokens, evidence bytes, tracking proofs or form payloads in telemetry, URLs or browser logs.

accessibility.keyboard_or_switch_navigation: All public and operator journeys are fully keyboard operable with no pointer-only action.
accessibility.screen_reader_or_talkback: Semantic landmarks, labels, status text and live regions expose navigation, validation and async outcomes.
accessibility.focus_management: Move focus intentionally to validation summaries, route-level errors, dialogs and post-navigation headings while preserving logical reading order.

unit.strategy: Test API mappers, Problem Details mapping, idempotency-key lifecycle, permission presentation and auth/session utilities.

component_or_ui.strategy: React component tests cover forms, semantic states, responsive behavior, permission presentation and public/admin Design System variants.

integration.strategy: Test Axios transport, TanStack Query orchestration, JWT lifecycle, headers, Problem Details and cache invalidation against controlled HTTP fixtures and the real API contract.

e2e.strategy: Critical intake, tracking and backoffice journeys execute against the real synthetic API before slice acceptance.

offline.storage_strategy: No durable browser persistence for authoritative claim data, evidence, tracking proofs or bearer tokens in the MVP. Ephemeral in-memory form state may remain visible while the current page is open.
offline.sync_conflict_policy: No queued business writes. After connectivity returns, refetch authoritative server state before explicit mutation retry; expired operator credentials require login again.

web.browser_support: Current evergreen desktop and mobile browsers, responsive from approximately 360px.
